issues.description: The exercise and template require a subroutine named 'set_pixel' (spec: accepts x in EAX, y in EBX, color in ECX; only EAX may be clobbered). The solution implementation instead defines a routine named 'write_pixel' (solution_repository/pixel.asm lines 19-34) and does not provide a symbol 'set_pixel', while the code in main still calls 'set_pixel' (call set_pixel at line 147). This name mismatch means the assembler/linker will not find the expected symbol and students following the template will encounter a missing-symbol/assembly failure or confusion mapping the required routine to the provided implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the subroutine name and symbol consistent across artifacts. Either rename the solution's 'write_pixel' label to 'set_pixel' and ensure its register-preservation and parameter usage match the problem specification (x in EAX, y in EBX, color in ECX; preserve all registers except EAX), or add a thin 'set_pixel' wrapper in the solution that forwards to 'write_pixel' (preserving required registers and using the same calling convention). Also ensure any calls in main refer to the implemented symbol.
